google_review_notes: No login required. All features of Solitaire are reachable from the main menu: Play (500 numbered Klondike deals, each verified winnable), Daily puzzle (the Daily Deal), Levels (deal list incl. Random deals in draw 1 / draw 3), Shop, Settings. Offline card game with AdMob ads and optional in-app purchases. Lives are only used by Random deals; numbered deals and the Daily Deal are free.
apple_review_notes: No login required. To test IAPs, open the Shop from Solitaire's main menu. No demo account needed.
